config.page.time.name: Time
config.page.time.tooltip: Settings related to the passage of in-game time.
config.page.time.description: Configure and control all features related to the passage of in-game time.
config.page.custom-time.name: Custom Time
config.page.custom-time.description: Set how much real time passes for every 10 minutes.
config.page.seated-time.name: Special Seating Acceleration
config.page.seated-time.tooltip: Speeds up the clock while the player is seated in specific locations.
config.page.seated-time.description: Clock acceleration works on the seats beside the tables in the Museum Library, the three selected benches near the Pelican Town fountain, the specific seats in the Saloon, and the specific bench on the Beach. Use the options below to enable or disable each location separately. The Library stops at 6:00 PM; the fountain, Saloon, and Beach stop at midnight. After the time limit, acceleration at outdoor locations cannot be reactivated until the next day.
config.page.24h.name: 24 Hours
config.page.24h.tooltip: Configure the 24-hour real-time day cycle and its balancing options.
config.page.24h.description: The real-time cycle targets a 24-hour in-game day. With balancing enabled, time accelerated while seated is compensated for during the remaining day. To prevent the clock from becoming excessively slow, compensation is capped at 24 minutes per 10 in-game minutes.
config.page.notifications.name: Notifications
config.page.notifications.description: Choose whether Stardew QOL displays notifications when an automatic feature starts or stops.
config.page.back-to-time.name: Back to Time
config.custom-time.enabled.name: Enable
config.custom-time.enabled.tooltip: Use the configured custom clock speed. When disabled, the game uses its default clock speed.
config.seconds-per-ten-minutes.name: Seconds per 10 minutes
config.seconds-per-ten-minutes.tooltip: Real-world time needed for 10 in-game minutes. The minimum is 7 seconds; higher values make the clock slower.
config.seated-time.enabled.name: Enable
config.seated-time.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables clock acceleration at special seating locations. Use the options below to control each location individually.
config.seated-time.speed.name: Seconds per 10 min
config.seated-time.speed.tooltip: Real-world time needed for 10 in-game minutes while seated at an enabled location: Fountain, Saloon, Library, or Beach. Lower values make the clock faster. Range: 1 to 3.5 seconds.
config.24h.cycle.name: 24-hour real-time cycle
config.24h.cycle.tooltip: Makes one complete in-game day target 24 real-world hours. This takes priority over the Custom Time speed. The seated-time feature can still accelerate the clock.
config.24h.balance.name: Balance 24h
config.24h.balance.tooltip: When the 24-hour cycle is enabled, adjusts the remaining clock speed to compensate for time accelerated while seated. Compensation is capped at 24 real minutes per 10 in-game minutes to prevent the clock from becoming excessively slow.
config.notifications.enabled.name: Show notifications
config.notifications.enabled.tooltip: Show or hide the start and end notifications for automatic features.
config.page.energy.name: Stamina
config.page.energy.description: Configure and control automatic stamina recovery. Each mode has its own amount and interval. Only one mode works at a time. After spending stamina, recovery waits for the cooldown. In the Spa hot springs area (BathHouse_Pool), the mod’s custom stamina recovery is suspended; it resumes when you leave that area. This lets the hot springs’ natural recovery work normally without stacking with the mod. While riding a horse, the player also recovers Stamina and Health using the same regeneration system applied when sitting.
config.page.back-to-energy.name: Back to Stamina
config.energy.module.enabled.name: Enable
config.energy.module.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables all stamina recovery features. Individual settings are preserved.
config.energy.general.name: General recovery
config.energy.general.description: Fallback recovery used when no enabled activity-specific mode applies.
config.energy.walking.name: While moving
config.energy.walking.description: Recovery used while the player is walking or running.
config.energy.idle.name: While standing still
config.energy.idle.description: Recovery used while the player is not moving.
config.energy.seated.name: While seated
config.energy.seated.description: Recovery while the character is sitting on any chair, bench, or seat. In special locations that speed up the clock (the Library, fountain benches, Saloon, and Beach Bench), regeneration is still counted in real-world seconds and does not speed up with the in-game clock. Sitting in these locations while the clock is accelerated grants a 20% bonus to the amount recovered.
config.energy.fishing.name: While holding a fishing rod
config.energy.fishing.description: Recover stamina while holding a fishing rod. The stamina cost of casting remains unchanged.
config.energy.cooldown.name: After spending stamina
config.energy.cooldown.description: After an action spends stamina, all automatic recovery pauses until this cooldown ends. The current activity mode then resumes; recovery is never stacked.
config.energy.mode.enabled.name: Enable
config.energy.mode.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables this recovery mode.
config.energy.amount.name: Stamina amount
config.energy.amount.tooltip: Amount of stamina restored each time this mode triggers.
config.energy.interval.name: Interval
config.energy.interval.tooltip: Real-world seconds between recovery triggers for this mode.
config.energy.cooldown.enabled.name: Enable
config.energy.cooldown.enabled.tooltip: Pauses automatic stamina recovery for a period after stamina is spent.
config.energy.cooldown.seconds.name: Cooldown duration
config.energy.cooldown.seconds.tooltip: Real-world seconds to wait after an action spends stamina. Range: 3 to 5 seconds.
config.time.module.enabled.name: Enable
config.time.module.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables all time-related features. Individual settings are preserved.
config.time.module.page.name: Time Module
config.time.module.page.tooltip: Enable or disable all time-related features.
config.time.module.page.description: Control the overall Time Module activation. When disabled, all time features are inactive, but their individual settings are preserved.
config.energy.module.page.name: Stamina Module
config.energy.module.page.tooltip: Enable or disable all stamina recovery features.
config.energy.module.page.description: Control the overall Stamina Module activation. When disabled, all automatic stamina recovery is inactive, but individual settings are preserved.
config.page.health.name: Health
config.page.health.description: Configure automatic health recovery. Each mode has its own amount and interval. Only one mode is used at a time. After taking damage, Health and Stamina wait for the shared cooldown.
config.page.back-to-health.name: Back to Health
config.health.module.page.name: Health Module
config.health.module.page.tooltip: Enable or disable all health recovery features.
config.health.module.page.description: Control the overall Health Module activation. When disabled, automatic health recovery and the shared damage cooldown are inactive, but individual settings are preserved.
config.health.module.enabled.name: Enable
config.health.module.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables automatic health recovery and the damage cooldown shared with Stamina.
config.health.general.name: General recovery
config.health.general.description: Fallback recovery used when no enabled activity-specific mode applies.
config.health.walking.name: While moving
config.health.walking.description: Recovery used while the player is walking or running.
config.health.idle.name: While standing still
config.health.idle.description: Recovery used while the player is not moving.
config.health.seated.name: While seated
config.health.seated.description: Recovery while the character is sitting on any chair, bench, or seat. In special locations that speed up the clock (the Library, fountain benches, Saloon, and Beach Bench), regeneration is still counted in real-world seconds and does not speed up with the in-game clock. Sitting in these locations while the clock is accelerated grants a 20% bonus to the amount recovered.
config.health.mode.enabled.name: Enable
config.health.mode.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables this recovery mode.
config.health.amount.name: Health amount
config.health.amount.tooltip: Amount of health restored each time this mode triggers. Since game health uses whole points, fractional values accumulate until they make a full point.
config.health.interval.name: Interval
config.health.interval.tooltip: Real-world seconds between recovery triggers for this mode.
config.health.damage-cooldown.name: After taking damage
config.health.damage-cooldown.descriptio: When the player takes damage, automatic Health and Stamina recovery pauses for the configured duration. This is one cooldown shared by both modules.
config.health.damage-cooldown.enabled.to: Pauses Health and Stamina recovery for a period after the player takes damage.
config.health.damage-cooldown.seconds.to: Real-world seconds to wait after taking damage. The default is 2 seconds; adjustable range: 2 to 4 seconds.
config.climate.chance.tooltip: Probability of the additional attempt on each eligible day. Adjustable from 1% to 75%. It does not replace or reduce the game's natural probability.
config.climate.limit.tooltip: Maximum number of days of this type added by the mod in each half of the month. The counter resets on days 1 and 15. Adjustable from 1 up to the maximum allowed for each type.
config.page.climate.description: Stardew QOL can add rainy, stormy, or snowy days without replacing weather naturally selected by the game. Chances are additional attempts on eligible sunny days. Limits count only days added by the mod and reset on days 1 and 15. Weather is calculated by the in-game calendar, with no extra rolls caused by clock speed or the 24-hour cycle.
config.page.climate.name: Climate
config.page.climate.tooltip: Configure the additional frequency of rain, storms, and snow.
config.page.back-to-climate.name: Back to Climate
config.climate.module.name: Climate Module
config.climate.module.description: Enable or disable the Climate module. Individual rain, storm, and snow settings are preserved.
config.climate.module.enabled.name: Enable
config.climate.module.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables all Climate module features.
config.climate.rain.name: Rain
config.climate.rain.description: Configure the additional chance and limit for rainy days added by the mod.
config.climate.storm.name: Storm
config.climate.storm.description: Configure the additional chance and limit for stormy days added by the mod.
config.climate.snow.name: Snow
config.climate.snow.description: Configure the additional chance and limit for snowy days added by the mod.
config.climate.type.enabled.name: Enable
config.climate.type.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables this additional weather type.
config.climate.chance.name: Additional chance
config.climate.limit.name: Limit per half-month
config.page.mod.name: Mod
config.page.mod.tooltip: Enable or disable the entire Stardew QOL mod.
config.page.mod.description: Control Stardew QOL's overall activation. When disabled, all mod systems and effects are suspended. Individual settings are preserved and take effect again when the mod is enabled.
config.mod.enabled.name: Enable Stardew QOL
config.mod.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables all Stardew QOL systems at once. Disabling does not erase your settings.
config.seated-time.fountain.name: Fountain
config.seated-time.fountain.tooltip: Speeds up the clock while seated on one of the three selected benches near the Pelican Town fountain. Acceleration ends at midnight.
config.seated-time.saloon.name: Saloon
config.seated-time.saloon.tooltip: Speeds up the clock while seated on one of the specific configured seats in the Saloon. Acceleration ends at midnight.
config.seated-time.library.name: Library
config.seated-time.library.tooltip: Speeds up the clock while seated at one of the seats beside the tables in the lower part of the Museum Library. Acceleration ends at 6:00 PM.
config.seated-time.beach.name: Beach
config.seated-time.beach.tooltip: Speeds up the clock while seated on the specific bench on the Beach. Acceleration ends at midnight.
